issues.note: Mandatory Sentinel-3 LST ICR 2322 returned MISSING_DATA on 17 Oct; audit run 16 Oct 23:24 UTC had already found/downloaded 15 Oct data, indicating a likely DCO retrieval failure. Optional GCOM-C LST ICR 2319 was also missing; audit through 17 Oct showed latest GCOM-C LST only 14 Oct, consistent with provider delay. Products 01/10 VOID; DL VOID package OK, ET N/A. OMC screenshots show Delivery Timeliness (Systematic) BREACH (Expired), 9d vs 8d, for both products on schedules 660, 661 and 662 (reference dates 14–16 Oct). The schedule cards show DL OK events before the displayed SLA+T2 deadlines; schedules 660 and 662 also show ET OK, while schedule 661 is VOID with ET N/A. The KPI dashboard lists product 01 twice per reference date, while schedule cards list products 01 and 10. Possible KPI event/product attribution or deadline inconsistency; cause not established. Trace: https://omc.iride.earth/#/monitoring/trace?requestId=ISS-domain_S5-296

Contradiction; cause unconfirmed. OMC trace: https://omc.iride.earth/#/monitoring/trace?requestId=ISS-domain_S5-297.
